scope: Eight numeric CPU Text Explorer kernels on externally tokenized term IDs and supplied DTM; restricted dense local models,not full language-aware JMP Text Explorer.

common_contract.input: Nonempty finite rectangular numeric data,abs<=1e12,<=131072cells,columns1..4096;<=16384finite args. JSONversion1. Missing/NaN/Infinity reject. All term/row ordering caller-owned and stable; empty documents represented by zero count rows or explicit n_documents in text_dtm. No empty-column SQL inputs.
common_contract.tokenization: No Unicode/string segmentation,normalization,language dictionaries,stemming,stopwords or synonym detection implemented. Caller supplies token IDs/counts and same fitted vocabulary for scoring; Japanese tokenization remains unsupported.
common_contract.weighting: Binary 1[x>0];ternary min(x,2);frequency x;log frequency log10(1+x);TF-IDF x*log10(N/df) without smoothing or document-length scaling. Training N includes empty documents. Terms selected by corpus count descending with original-index ties. Saved IDF never refits query documents.
common_contract.svd_normalization: Follow literal JMP19.2 LSA help: divide uncentered matrix by n;centered/scaled by n-1. Centered-scaled uses sample standard deviation,constant columns scale1. This states the numeric contract; it is not sqrt(n) or sqrt(n-1) normalization. The help also describes PCA equivalence; no installed-JMP singular-value scale comparison has been performed,so that prose is not treated as independent validation.
common_contract.lsa_scores: For transformed A,approximation U*S*V^T. document_vectors=U,document_scores=US,term_vectors=V. Saved projection V scores US. Sign anchor is maximum absolute term-vector entry positive,source index tie. Repeated singular values allow alternative bases; compare subspace/reconstruction. Relative reconstruction error uses actual normalized residual,not subtracting close energies.
common_contract.topic_scores: L=V*S;orthogonal R from varimax;topic_loadings=L*R,document_scores=U*R,so scores*loadings^T=U*S*V^T. Projection=V*S^-1*R. Objective=sum_j[sum_i Z_ij^4-(sum_i Z_ij^2)^2/p],Z=L/max_abs(L),then optional Kaiser unit row norms. varimax_loading_scale records max_abs(L). rotation convergence concerns local sweeps only. Positive topic energy underflow or unrepresentable projection coefficients rejects with rescale guidance.
common_contract.latent_class: P(x)=sum_c pi_c product_t theta_ct^presence(1-theta_ct)^absence. Exact logsumexp E step;M step weighted means clamped to supplied probability bounds. Stop requires relative LL change<=tol and maximum parameter step<=sqrt(tol). Component mass<=1e-12 errors. Components canonically sorted by mixture probability then lexicographic term probability.
common_contract.diagnostics: LCA separates optimizer_converged,components_distinct,necessary dimension bound(k*p+k-1 <= 2^p-1),and identification_verified=false. converged requires optimizer convergence and passes these necessary degeneracy checks; they do not prove statistical identification. AIC/BIC are descriptive conventional parameter penalties and null unless converged; no inference/calibration guarantee for singular mixtures. Varimax reports local rotation_converged separately.
common_contract.resources: DTM output dimensions<=4096,cells<=131072. LSA n<=1024,p<=128,k<=32,n*p*p<=1M,100Jacobi sweeps. Topic k<=16,p*k*k*sweeps<=50M,max2000sweeps. LCA n2..2048,p<=128,k<=16,n*p*k*maxiter<=100M,maxiter2000. Scoring outputcells<=131072. Derived nonfinite results error.

operations.description: Aggregate supplied numeric tokens into a document-term count matrix; rows[document_id0based,term_id0based,count]; args[n_documents,n_terms]. Caller tokenizes and defines immutable vocabulary.
operations.data: Long token-count records,duplicates summed; IDs nonnegative integers within supplied dimensions,count integer0..1e9; aggregate cell<=1e9. Zero-count records supported; explicit empty documents preserved.
unsupported: No string tokenization,Unicode normalization,Japanese dictionary,stemming,stopword or synonym fitting

operations.description: Fit corpus dictionary/filter and exact JMP five DTM weightings; nonnegative integer count matrix; args[mode0binary/1ternary/2frequency/3log10/4TFIDF=4,min_corpus_count=1,max_terms=all].
operations.data: Dense count matrix in immutable source vocabulary order,count integer0..1e9. Training frequency filters and top-term ordering are corpus count descending,source-index ascending ties; empty documents count in N.
unsupported: No smoothed IDF,document-length normalization,automatic language preprocessing or dictionary from query data

operations.description: Apply saved dictionary and training IDF to new count rows; args unchanged text_weight.weight_parameters; training vocabulary width/order required.
operations.data: Dense query counts in entire original p-term universe; absent terms0; unselected training terms ignored. Unknown external words must be excluded/mapped by caller; out-of-range numeric IDs/width reject.
args: unchanged weight_parameters layout [version1,original_term_count p,selected_count k,weight_mode,training_n,selected_term_indices(k),training_IDF(k)],length5+2k; original ID universe retained
unsupported: No query IDF refit or inferred new vocabulary; OOV words are not automatically tokenized

operations.description: Partial SVD of supplied nonnegative weighted DTM; args[k,preprocess0uncentered/1centered/2centered_scaled=2]; returns U,S,V and scores US with saved transform.
operations.data: Supplied weighted DTM (use text_weight first if desired),n<=1024,p<=128,n*p*p<=1e6,k<=32 and numerical rank. Relative rank cutoff1e-10; one-sided Jacobi100sweeps; constant centered columns scale1.
unsupported: No automatic TF-IDF fitting,model-rank selection,sparse unlimited corpus or installed-JMP equivalence of singular-value scale; repeated singular subspaces need not have unique vectors

operations.description: Score supplied weighted query DTM with saved LSA/topic projection; args unchanged projection_parameters. Training mean,scale,divisor and loadings reused.
operations.data: Nonnegative weighted query matrix in exact fitted term order. Input columns<=128,output dimensions<=32,output<=131072cells; finite derived binary64 outputs required. TF-IDF must use original training model separately.
unsupported: No query preprocessing refit,OOV inference,uncertainty or guaranteed finite result when derived binary64 terms overflow

operations.description: True orthogonal varimax of supplied-DTM SVD loadings VS; document topic vectors UR preserve reconstruction; args[k,preprocess=2,max_sweeps=200,tol=1e-8,kaiser0/1=1].
operations.data: Same supplied-DTM SVD bounds; k<=16. Loadings initially VS; common max-absolute loading scaling before optional Kaiser row normalization,then pairwise orthogonal Jacobi varimax. Final maximum absolute term-loading anchor positive.
args: k integer1..16 and numerical rank required
unsupported: No NMF/LDA/probabilistic-topic claim,global rotation maximum,automatic topic naming,GUI wordcloud or installed-JMP exact rotation reproduction

operations.description: Conditional-independence Bernoulli mixture EM on supplied count presence; args[k,seed=0,max_iter=200,tol=1e-8,probability_floor=1e-9]. Reports genuine likelihood,mixture/term probabilities and saved posterior model.
operations.data: Count matrix binarized by presence,training n2..2048,p<=128,k<=16 and<=n,n*p*k*iterations<=100M. Deterministic SplitMix64 seeded shuffled distinct document indices initialize .75/.25 conditional probabilities.
unsupported: No global optimum or verified statistical identification,SE/CI,LDA/NMF,sparse JMP Text Explorer implementation identity,term-selection regression or sentiment dictionary

operations.description: Score saved Bernoulli mixture using presence and absence of each fitted term; args unchanged text_latent_class.predict_parameters; returns posterior membership and log probability.
operations.data: Dense query count matrix in fixed p-term order,counts converted to presence; saved probabilities/mixing weights validated. Output<=131072cells.
unsupported: No refitting,term-map inference,classification calibration or guarantee supplied arbitrary parameter vectors represent identified fitted models
